  "title": "Synchronize with internet always activated",
  "body": "I updated to OpenKeychain 3.8 via F-Droid on CM 12.1\nIn the key editing dialog there's a checkbox saying \"Synchronize with the internet\" being checked.\nWhen I uncheck it and press save, OpenKeyChain tells me that there's \"nothing to do\". So when I close the dialog and open it again, the checkbox is checked again.\n\nWhy is it activated by default anyway? I don't want to share my key. I'd prefer the option to be opt-in and not opt-out, because there's usually not opt-out on the keyservers, once it got synchronized... :-(\n",

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "The key is only uploaded to a keyserver when you actually change identities and press save. If nothing is changed OpenKeychain will show \"nothing to do\".\n\nWe should change the text on that checkbox to say \"Synchronize with the Internet on Save\" or something like this and maybe move it into the Toolbar.\nLong term solution is to make a global preference if keys should be uploaded or not or a way to flag keys which should be uploaded and which not.\n"
    },

      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "> The key is only uploaded to a keyserver when you actually change identities and press save. If nothing is changed OpenKeychain will show \"nothing to do\".\n\nThank you for the clarification.\n\n> Long term solution is to make a global preference if keys should be uploaded or not or a way to flag keys which should be uploaded and which not.\n\nThat sounds fair to me. I strongly support this solution. \nPlease don't forget to mention if the key already has been synchronized or not. Right now I don't know if I accidentally uploaded my key already unless I search it on the web myself.\n"
